# WO-615: Research: legitimate machine-readable ways to find a person's listings (official APIs, broker self-service, opt-out portals)
Status: queued (in-house)
Vendor: claude
Agent: broker-researcher (Priya Shah)
Kind: research
Tier: standard
Severity: MEDIUM
Owner contact: Morgan Reyes
Target release: 0.4
Source: owner direction 2026-11-11 ("find a way to fully automate"), after WO-601 showed every people-search page blocks a cloud fetch. PII-free by rule.
Boundary (all WOs 612-616): shared rule 5 stands. No CAPTCHA solving, no stealth plugins, no solver services, no UA or fingerprint spoofing, no proxies or IP rotation. "Fully automated" here means: the app does every step a machine may do, from the person's own computer, and asks the person only for the one click a site reserves for humans, batched so it happens rarely.

## Goal
Find every route that lets software find or remove listings without scraping a page that refuses machines: published APIs, opt-out portals that return a match list, state data-broker registries with deletion mechanisms (e.g. California DROP, as a model for other states), and search APIs whose terms allow programmatic use. `engine/search_engines.py` rules out querying Google/Bing pages (terms); an official API with terms that permit it is a different question and needs a cited answer.

## Deliverable
`docs/research/AUTOMATION_ROUTES.md`: per route, what it covers, terms (quoted, linked), cost, data sent, and a go/no-go. One proposed WO per "go".

## Allowed paths
- `docs/research/AUTOMATION_ROUTES.md` (new)
- `docs/handoff/broker-researcher.md`

## Check-in plan
Orchestrator reviews; any paid or account-based route is an owner decision (rule 6: never pay, never create accounts without the permission flag).
